run_time_in_zone_detection: run RF-DETR object detection with dwell time tracking in polygon zones on a video file
load_rfdetr_model: load an RF-DETR model (nano, small, medium, base, large) for a specified device and resolution
adjust_inference_resolution: adjust an input resolution to the nearest valid value for the chosen RF-DETR model size
create_polygon_zones: create polygon-based zones for tracking object dwell time in video frames
annotate_video_with_detections: annotate video frames with detection colors, labels, and zone dwell times using ByteTrack
